searches.finding: 0009 de-pins an A-pinned i8 add counter from class Ac; the squatter here is a gpr return byte, not an add, so 0009 does not apply. Both 0009 and 0015 are present in every tested binary (they predate all three installs).

earlier_sightings.detail: lzss-gallery.c non-LTO -Os, +mos-a16 and +mos-a16+mos-xy16, before and after -mos-recover-near-nowrap: all exit 1 with 'ran out of registers ... record_result'. Recorded as a census failure, not investigated.
Step 6: lzss-gallery precodegen.bc fails identically on baseline and candidate llc; noted as an SDK program build failure reproduced on the baseline.
The originating report: fails with the pre-0071 clang-23 254624ba and with clang-23 e532fbee (the latter is the clang of build/llvm-mos-install.6f303945).

upstream: +mos-a16 does not exist in upstream llvm-mos: /opt/llvm-mos (0f031168a7cc) ignores the feature and compiles the reduced input (runs/upstream-opt-llvm-mos). The upstream-bound split series carries the defect: the reduced IR fails on the round-seven frozen builds r7-321-16 (#321 top), r7-320-4 (#320 top) and r7-fw-12 (far-word top) and compiles on p-321-00 (upstream base 06bc967d2668, feature unrecognised).
conclusion: No existing canonical record covers this failure. It belongs to the same family as the a16regpress exhaustion (an unspillable single-instruction Ac16 transit cannot obtain $a16 while an 8-bit value occupies $a) but has a different squatter and trigger: a gpr return-value byte, coalesced across blocks and hinted to $a by the return copy, rather than an A-pinned add counter; 0009's change is present and does not prevent it.
